scope: OBS02 partial: real WAMR preparation/destruction call gates with cancellation, exact controller expiry, cleanup cutoff and unrelated actual worker progress.
gates: After real wasm_runtime_instantiate returns, before KaOS assigns the instance/resolves entries/publishes preparation
Before real wasm_runtime_deinstantiate, after execution-environment destruction; instance/module/arena/artifact remain owned
mechanism: GNU ld wrappers confined to new Linux test executable; unchanged production runtime and restricted guest. Unload wrapper checks !disposed before/after actual unload and records completion.
oracle: Target preparation gate reached before submitting second artifact
Other actual worker reaches accepted INIT while preparation held
Removal/expiry applied before release; zero target entry attempts and no startup history for faults
Both allocation charges, reservation and live worker access retained while disposal blocked
Pending at cleanup deadline-1; Unresolved at equality; no CLEANED from deadline passage
Other node remains running/uncancelled until separate removal and completes actual cleanup while target held
Deinstantiate/unload return before observed disposed/CLEANED; all charges/reservations released
No-fault startup succeeds; late cleanup preserves historical success or resolves failed addition/removal appropriately
Expected event order and identical repeat, finite ledger checked for overflow; repeated control pass does not double reclaim

reviews.spec: Strengthened unload ordering and checked destructor completion at CLEANED, before shutdown. No remaining blocking finding.
reviews.simplicity_and_concurrency: Strengthened unrelated liveness immediately before removal and explicit expected ledger order. No production API or embedded storage added.

skips.default_workloads: One three-node local pipeline skipped in two-node profile; runs in four-node profile

sandbox_notes: Initial CMake regeneration blocked writing WAMR generated version header in sibling dependency tree; authorized build passed.
Sandboxed focused test encountered LeakSanitizer ptrace restriction; authorized focused/full runs outside sandbox passed with leak checking enabled.
default-focused.log precedes review-only assertions; full-suite logs correspond to final source hashes.
limitations: Linux host call boundaries, not arbitrary internal WAMR instruction gates
Controller deadline injection does not establish real-clock timing, latency or ESP32 behavior
No channel, UDP, collector or whole-process fault/replay scenario
Ledger records imposed partial order, not complete loss-accounted concurrent runtime observations
Does not close Q14/P9 or the transport scheduling increment
